name: Get Patient Details
description: Looks up a patient in the hospital ERP by phone number (Magrabi demo).
function_description: Look up a patient in the hospital ERP by phone number. Returns patient_id, full name, MRN, national ID, date of birth, last visit and medical history. Use this right after capturing the caller's phone number to recognize returning patients so you never re-ask for details already on file. An empty result means the caller is a new patient.

phone_number.description: The patient's phone number as digits (country code optional, e.g. 971501234567). Matching is tolerant of missing '+' or country code.

name: Update Patient Record
description: Corrects fields (name spelling, phone, DOB) on an existing patient record in the hospital ERP (Magrabi demo).
function_description: Correct the details on an EXISTING patient record — name spelling, phone number, date of birth or gender. Requires the patient_id from get_patient_details or find_appointments in THIS call, and only for a record the caller has confirmed is theirs. Use when the caller says their details are wrong or asks to correct the record (e.g. a misspelled name). The corrected name appears immediately in all appointment lookups. NEVER use this to change a record to a different person — someone new on this phone is a new patient, not an update.

patient_id.description: The patient's id, exactly as returned by get_patient_details or find_appointments in THIS call. Never guess it.

name.description: The corrected full name, only if the name is being fixed (apply the caller's spelling).

phone.description: The corrected phone number as digits, only if the phone is being changed on the record.

dob.description: The corrected date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD, only if being fixed.

gender.description: The corrected gender, only if being fixed.

error_mapping.404: No patient record exists with that patient_id. Re-run get_patient_details to get the correct id.
error_mapping.400: The update was incomplete — pass patient_id plus at least one field to change.

name: Yaqeen Identity Verification
description: Verifies a new patient's National ID / Iqama against the national registry (Magrabi demo, mocked).
function_description: Verify a NEW patient's identity against the national Yaqeen registry using their National ID / Iqama number and date of birth. Returns the verified full name, gender, nationality and DOB — use these to register the patient (pass national_id, dob and gender to book_appointment). If verified is false, fall back to fast registration and ask for the full name instead. Only use this for patients NOT found by get_patient_details.

national_id.description: The National ID or Iqama number, digits only (e.g. 1055667788).

dob.description: The caller's date of birth, format YYYY-MM-DD. Used to confirm the identity match.

name: Get Departments
description: Lists the live departments and their branches (Magrabi demo).
function_description: List all live departments and the branch each one operates at (Eye Care at Dubai DHCC, Abu Dhabi, Al Ain and Mirdif; ENT Care at Abu Dhabi only). Returns the department_id values needed by get_doctors and check_availability. Call this once when a booking starts and remember the ids for the rest of the call.

name: Get Doctors
description: Fetches the live doctor roster with specialty, department and branch (Magrabi demo).
function_description: Fetch the LIVE doctor roster from the hospital ERP, with each doctor's doctor_id, specialty, department and branch. This is the ONLY source of doctor names — never recite doctors from memory. Filter by department_id (preferred) or branch. Name at most two or three relevant doctors to the caller, never the full list.

department_id.description: Filter by department_id from get_departments (a department_id already implies one branch).

branch.description: Optional branch filter: 'Dubai DHCC', 'Abu Dhabi', 'Al Ain' or 'Mirdif'.

name: Check Availability
description: Returns the free 30-minute appointment slots for a date (Magrabi demo).
function_description: Get the FREE 30-minute appointment slots for one date, either for a specific doctor (doctor_id) or for every doctor in a department (department_id). Each slot carries an availability_id — that exact id is what book_appointment and reschedule_appointment need. Always call this before offering or confirming any time. An empty list means that day is fully booked.

date.description: The date to check, format YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-07-22).

doctor_id.description: Check one specific doctor's slots (doctor_id from get_doctors).

department_id.description: Check all doctors of one department and branch (department_id from get_departments). Use this when the caller has no doctor preference.

name: Book Appointment
description: Books a free slot in the hospital ERP and returns the booking number (Magrabi demo).
function_description: Book an appointment in the hospital ERP by reserving one free slot. Pass the availability_id of the slot the caller picked (from check_availability in THIS call). For a returning patient pass their patient_id from get_patient_details; for a new patient pass patient_name and phone instead (plus national_id, dob and gender when Yaqeen verified them) and the patient is registered automatically with a new medical record number. Returns the booking_number to read to the caller, plus the confirmed doctor, branch and time. If the slot was taken in the meantime the call fails with HTTP 409 — re-check availability and offer another time.

availability_id.description: The availability_id of the chosen free slot, exactly as returned by check_availability in THIS call. Never invent it.

patient_id.description: The patient's id from get_patient_details. Omit for a brand-new patient.

patient_name.description: The patient's full name. Required when patient_id is not passed (new patient). For a Yaqeen-verified patient use the verified full name.

phone.description: The patient's phone number as digits (e.g. 971501234567). Required when patient_id is not passed.

national_id.description: New patients only: the National ID or Iqama number, if the caller gave one.

dob.description: New patients only: date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format, if known.

gender.description: New patients only: gender, if Yaqeen returned it.

reason.description: The medical reason for the visit, e.g. 'LASIK consultation' or 'hearing test'.

error_mapping.409: That slot was just taken by someone else. Re-run check_availability for the same day and offer the caller a different time.
error_mapping.400: The booking details were incomplete. For a returning patient pass patient_id; for a new patient pass patient_name and phone.

name: Find Appointments
description: Finds a patient's scheduled appointments by phone number (Magrabi demo).
function_description: Find a patient's SCHEDULED appointments by phone number. This is the ONLY source of an appointment_id for reschedule_appointment and cancel_appointment. Returns appointment_id, booking_number, patient name, doctor, department, branch, date and time, and reason for each match. An empty result means nothing is booked under that number — ask whether it could be under a different number before giving up.

phone_number.description: The phone number the appointment is booked under, as digits (country code optional). Matching is tolerant of missing '+' or country code.

name: Reschedule Appointment
description: Atomically moves an existing appointment to a new slot (Magrabi demo).
function_description: Atomically move an existing appointment to a new slot: it reserves the new slot, frees the old one and updates the appointment in a single transaction. Requires the real appointment_id from find_appointments in THIS call, and the new slot's availability_id from check_availability in THIS call. Never pass a guessed or placeholder id. If it fails, the original appointment is unchanged — tell the caller honestly and offer another time.

appointment_id.description: The appointment_id exactly as returned by find_appointments in THIS call. Never guess or reuse one.

new_availability_id.description: The availability_id of the new free slot, from check_availability in THIS call.

error_mapping.409: The new slot was just taken, or the appointment is no longer active. The original appointment still stands — re-check availability and offer another time.
error_mapping.404: No appointment exists with that id. Re-run find_appointments to get the correct appointment_id.

name: Cancel Appointment
description: Cancels an appointment and frees its slot (Magrabi demo).
function_description: Cancel an existing appointment: it is marked cancelled and its slot is released for other patients. Requires the real appointment_id from find_appointments in THIS call — never guess or build one. Only call this after the caller has explicitly confirmed the cancellation.

appointment_id.description: The appointment_id exactly as returned by find_appointments in THIS call. Never guess or build one.

error_mapping.404: No appointment exists with that id. Re-run find_appointments to get the correct appointment_id.
